PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Foundation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational strength using bodyweight"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Push Focus":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3m
          arm_circles 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pike_push_up 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 1m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x3 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          superman 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Legs and Core":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
    WEEK 2:
